about.title: About Us - Seen Memory
about.subtitle: We preserve your most precious moments, scene after scene
about.text1: At Seen Memory, we believe that the most beautiful moments of life deserve to be preserved clearly and emotionally. We are more than just a storage platform – we are a digital memory album for your life's journey.

hero.description: At Scene Memory, we believe every moment deserves to last. We're here to help you capture, organize, and remember the important events in your life.

our_story.title: How Our Journey Began
our_story.intro: It all started with a simple idea: How can we help people preserve the precious memories that shape their lives?
our_story.stage1_desc: In 2020, our founders noticed how many important moments fade over time. They decided to build a simple yet powerful tool to preserve these memories.
our_story.stage2_desc: As users grew, we added smart reminders, advanced categorization, and secure sharing with loved ones.
our_story.stage3_desc: Today, we aim to be the world's best platform for memory preservation and organization — with strong focus on privacy and seamless experience.

mission_vision.mission_text: Our mission is to empower everyone to preserve their precious memories in an easy, secure, and organized way. We believe every moment in life deserves to be saved and remembered.
mission_vision.value_people_first_desc: User experience drives every decision we make
mission_vision.value_privacy_desc: Your memories stay private — we never share them
mission_vision.value_growth_desc: We evolve constantly to meet our users' needs
mission_vision.vision_text: We aspire to be the world's leading platform for capturing and organizing memories — accessible, secure, and effortless for anyone, anywhere.
